quote: Eye sizes and interdistances: AME 0.30, ALE 0.21, PME 0.20, PLE 0.21; AME–AME 0.17, AME–ALE 0.12, PME–PME 0.16, PME–PLE 0.32, ALE–PLE 0.05.
note: new trait key eye_diameter_mm as on main (Speleoticus hei, desk-d349; Hongkongia liutang, desk-d357), Methods define eye size as maximum dorsal diameter. Registry: World Spider Catalog spec-data/69618 (species/63145) lists Mallinella medog Wang, Mu, Lu, Xu & Zhang, 2024, Zodariidae Thorell, 1881, accepted, no synonymy or transfer, original description ZooKeys 1200: 183-198, p. 190. eye: AME (anterior median eye), maximum dorsal diameter
method: measurement of the preserved male holotype as listed in the species Description; Methods: 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum dorsal diameter.' and 'All measurements are in millimetres.'
conditions: Male holotype SWUCT-ZOD-05-01, Yadong County, 3044 m, Xizang, China, 10 July 2018, L. Wang, Z. Wu & Y. Mu leg.; the same sentence gives ALE 0.20, PME 0.20, PLE 0.23; paratype and female values not recorded. One eye per record, as for Speleoticus hei (desk-d349, audit 464).
